 Intern - Software Developer

 Location: 

 Bethpage, NY, US, 11714

 Brand: 

 Optimum

 Requisition #: 

 12508

 Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today! 

 We are Optimum, a leader in the fast-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. 

 At Optimum, co-op/intern students work on real projects with real business impact. Participants gain hands-on experience, collaborate with industry professionals, and contribute to initiatives that help shape the future of connectivity, technology, and customer experiences. Students may work on meaningful projects, gain exposure to industry-leading technologies, partner with mentors, develop professional skills, and build networks across the organization.

 Program Details  

• Full-time co-op/intern opportunity (Jan 2027 - Jul 2027)  

• 40-hour work week 

• 30-minute unpaid lunch period each workday 

 If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!   
 Job Summary 
 
 We are looking for a motivated Software Developer Co-op to join a software engineering team. You will pair with experienced developers to design, build, test, and deploy backend services and APIs. Assignments may focus on Python, Go, Java, or both, depending on team needs and your strengths.
This is a hands-on role: you will write production code, participate in code reviews, troubleshoot issues in shared environments, and learn how a mature software organization delivers on GCP using Cursor, GitLab and Atlassian.

 Responsibilities 
 
 •    Implement features, bug fixes, and small services under the guidance of a mentor and tech lead
•    Write clean, tested code in Python, following team conventions and secure coding standards
•    Build and run services on Google Cloud Platform (e.g., Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager—exposure varies by team)
•    Use GitLab for source control, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, and code review
•    Track work in Jira, document decisions in Confluence, and participate in agile ceremonies
•    Contribute to automated tests and help keep pipelines green
•    Investigate defects and learn observability basics (logging, metrics, alerts)
•    Present your work at an end-of-term demo or knowledge-sharing session

 Qualifications 
 
 Required

• Enrolled in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related co-op program 

• Coursework in data structures, algorithms, and at least one programming language 

• Familiarity with Git (branching, commits, merge requests) 

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication 
 
 Preferred

• Experience with Go and/or Java 

• Exposure to REST APIs, JSON, and SQL 

• Cloud computing or Linux command-line experience 

• Familiarity with Docker, GitLab, and Jira 
 
 Technologies & Tools

 Languages: Python
Cloud: Google Cloud Platform
DevOps: GitLab (repos, MRs, CI/CD)
Planning: Atlassian Jira, Confluence

 How We Work
Agile squads with two-week sprints, trunk-based development via GitLab merge requests, mandatory code review, CI quality gates, dedicated mentorship, and security-first practices (no secrets in code).

 What You Will Gain
Production experience on GCP, fluency with GitLab and Atlassian, backend/API and cloud-native patterns, professional code review skills, and a portfolio of real merge requests.

 At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stop.

 If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

 All job descriptions and required skills, qualifications and responsibilities for a particular position are subject to modification by the Company from time to time, in the Company’s discretion based on business necessity.

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to recruiting, hiring and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds regardless of gender, race, color, creed, national origin, religion, age, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.
 
 The Company collects personal information about its applicants for employment that may include personal identifiers, professional or employment related information, photos, education information and/or protected classifications under federal and state law. This information is collected for employment purposes, including identification, work authorization, FCRA-compliant background screening, human resource administration and compliance with federal, state and local law.

 Applicants for employment with The Company will never be asked to provide money (even if reimbursable) as part of the job application or hiring process. Please review our Fraud FAQ for further details.
 
 Pay is competitive and based on a number of job-related factors, including skills and experience. The starting pay rate/range at time of hire for this position in the posted location is $25.00 / Hour. The rate/range provided herein is the anticipated pay at the time of hire and does not reflect future job opportunity.

The Company will not provide current or future sponsorship for this role.

 Read through our Internships FAQ to help answer any questions you may have about internships at Shopify.
 Being a Shopify Intern
 Our hiring process is unique. We hire interns and place them on teams we think they’d be successful on. We match interns with teams based on their experience, interest, and what works best for Shopify.
 We are looking primarily for interns to fill a large number of internship roles in Software Engineering:
 
• Software Engineering: crafting the code that powers commerce, creating the extendable products that scale the entire commerce stack.
 Candidates with relevant experience may also be considered for internships within these areas:
 
• Infrastructure Engineering: building and developing the blocks that move all of Shopify forward.
 
• Security Engineering: detecting, evaluating, and addressing security threats to Shopify and its merchants.
 Shopify is a big part of the Ruby and Rails communities, and we’re constantly improving our codebase to make it even better. You do not need prior Rails experience to apply to this internship!
 Working at Shopify
 
• You must be legally entitled to work in the location you are applying to for the entire duration of the summer internship term (May 10 or June 14 - Aug 27, 2027). Shopify does not provide immigration support to intern candidates. 
 
• This internship is a 4-month long, full-time, paid experience - interns are expected not to be enrolled in school full-time while working at Shopify.
 As an Intern you must be able to work from one of our offices:
 Canada
 
• Montréal, Québec (490 Rue De la Gauchetière O)
 
• Ottawa, Ontario (151 O’Connor Street)
 
• Toronto, Ontario (620 King West)
 
 Please note: if you don’t currently live in one of the above cities, you must be willing and able to relocate for in-office experiences at one of these offices. If successful in your application, we will match you to a team when you start at Shopify. We’re unable to accommodate requests for particular teams and location changes once an offer is signed.
 Onboarding
 
• Interns must be located in their office city by the first day of onboarding and be ready to work 9:00am - 5:00pm. Interns cannot work from outside of the country they are hired in during their internship.
 Qualifications
 
• You love challenging yourself with projects or hacking just for fun
 
• You are a constant learner
 
• You have a passion for solving tough problems with code
 
• You take ownership of the projects you work on
 
• You enjoy research and figuring out how pieces of an entire project work
 
• You take pride in creating simple solutions to complex problems
 
• You have a strong commitment to quality
 Compensation: 
This role currently has a base pay range of CAD $76,800 to $84,700 for Canada per annum, based on a candidate's experience and qualifications. Interns also receive a monthly allowance of CAD $1000 (Canada) to use however best supports them during their internship.
 Additional Information
 In your application
 
• Include your resume
 
• Answer all of the application questions
 
• Once you submit your application, and if you move forward in our process, you’ll then be emailed a series of mandatory assessments to complete. These will help assess your technical skills and your likelihood of success at Shopify.
 We know that applying for internships can be time-consuming, and we truly appreciate your effort. The Early Talent Programs Team are actual real live people (👋🏻) and we’re looking forward to learning more about you through your application.
 Applications will close on November 30, 2026 at 11:59pm EDT. 
 
 – 
 
 Description du poste 
 Consultez notre FAQ (questions fréquentes) sur les stages pour répondre à toutes vos questions sur le programme de stages chez Shopify.
 Être stagiaire chez Shopify 
 Notre processus de recrutement est unique. Nous embauchons des stagiaires, puis les intégrons aux équipes où ils sont le plus susceptibles de réussir, en fonction de leur expérience, de leurs intérêts et des besoins de Shopify.
 Nous recherchons principalement des stagiaires pour plusieurs postes en ingénierie logicielle :
 
• Ingénierie logicielle : concevoir le code qui propulse le commerce et créer des produits évolutifs capables d’accompagner la croissance de l’ensemble de notre écosystème commercial.
 Les personnes possédant une expérience pertinente peuvent également être considérées pour des stages dans les domaines suivants :
 
• Ingénierie des infrastructures : concevoir, bâtir et faire évoluer les fondations technologiques qui soutiennent Shopify.
 
• Ingénierie de la sécurité : détecter, évaluer et contrer les menaces qui pèsent sur la sécurité de Shopify et de ses marchands.
 Shopify joue un rôle important au sein des communautés Ruby on Rails, et nous améliorons continuellement notre base de code afin de la rendre plus performante. Aucune expérience préalable avec Rails n’est requise pour postuler à ce stage !
 Travailler chez Shopify 
 
• Vous devez être légalement autorisé à travailler au Canada pendant toute la durée du stage d'été 2027 (du 10 mai ou 14 juin au 27 août 2027). Shopify ne propose pas de soutien en matière d’immigration pour les stagiaires. 
 
• Ce stage est une expérience rémunérée à temps plein d’une durée de quatre mois. Les stagiaires doivent être disponibles à temps plein et ne pas être inscrits à des études à temps plein pendant leur stage chez Shopify.
 En tant que stagiaire, vous devez être en mesure de travailler depuis l'un de nos bureaux:
 Canada
 
• Montréal, Québec (490 Rue De la Gauchetière O)
 
• Ottawa, Ontario (151, rue O'Connor)
 
• Toronto, Ontario (620 King Ouest)
 Veuillez noter : si vous ne résidez pas actuellement dans l'une des villes mentionnées ci-dessus, vous devez être disposé et en mesure de vous relocaliser pour des expériences en présentiel dans l'un de ces bureaux. Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous assignerons à une équipe au moment de votre arrivée chez Shopify. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure d’accepter les demandes de placement dans une équipe précise ni les changements de lieu une fois l’offre signée.
 Intégration 
 
• Les stagiaires doivent être présents dans leur ville de travail dès le premier jour de leur intégration (24 mai ou 14 juin 2027) et être prêts à travailler de 9 h à 17 h. Vous ne pouvez pas travailler en dehors du pays prévu durant votre stage.
 Profil recherché 
 
• Vous souhaitez vous lancer des défis, que ce soit à travers des projets ou du hacking pour le plaisir.
 
• Vous avez toujours soif d’apprendre.
 
• Vous aimez résoudre des problèmes complexes avec du code.
 
• Vous travaillez de manière autonome et prenez pleinement en charge les projets qui vous sont confiés.
 
• Vous aimez la recherche et comprendre comment les différentes parties d’un projet s’articulent.
 
• Vous savez trouver des solutions simples aux problèmes complexes.
 
• La qualité est au cœur de votre travail.
 Rémunération
 Ce poste offre actuellement une échelle salariale de base de 76 800 $ à 84 700 $ CAD pour le Canada par année, selon l'expérience et les qualifications du candidat. Les stagiaires reçoivent également une allocation mensuelle de 1 000 $ CAD (Canada) à utiliser comme bon leur semble pour les soutenir pendant leur stage.
 Informations supplémentaires
 Dans votre candidature 
 
• Ajoutez votre CV
 
• Répondez à toutes les questions indiquées
 
• Une fois votre candidature soumise, si vous êtes retenu pour la suite du processus, nous vous enverrons par e-mail une liste d’évaluations obligatoires à compléter. Celles-ci permettront d’évaluer vos compétences techniques et vos chances de succès chez Shopify.
 Nous savons que la recherche d’un stage peut être longue et pénible, et nous vous remercions sincèrement pour votre investissement. Notre équipe du programme de stages est composée de vraies personnes (👋🏻) et nous avons hâte d’en apprendre davantage sur vous à travers votre candidature.
 Les candidatures seront acceptées jusqu’au 30 novembre 2026 à 23h59 (heure de l'Est). 

 Apply now 
 Shopify https://www.shopify.com 
 
 About the discipline Engineering. It’s our DNA. 

 Engineering isn't a department at Shopify. It's our DNA. The engineers who thrive here care about the code, the system, and the merchants relying on both. They want hard problems and uncomfortable growth. They find solutions without waiting for permission. They ship weekly. They want commerce to work better for everyone. So does our founder, Tobi, who still codes and still shapes where this thing is going.
 They're open source nerds. They pair program because two brains write better code than one. New tools, new models, new approaches. They experiment constantly. Most of what's standard here started as someone hacking on something.
 They use AI like a keyboard, reflexively and everywhere, to clear the mundane and make room for thinking. And they work in the open. The fastest way to learn here is to watch someone better than you do the work. If that sounds like you, come build with us.

 Growth and rewards Mastery-matched compensation.
 Explore rewards 
 ~Mastery
 At Shopify, getting better at your craft and increasing your impact is how you grow. Twice a year, we assess both in our ~Mastery cycle, Shopify’s performance review. Achieving higher ~Mastery is a promotion, and when you earn a promotion your total rewards grow with it. Crafter and manager are equal paths, so you can pursue excellence in the craft you’re best at.

 Total Rewards
 With Flex Comp, your Rewards Wallet gives you agency over your compensation mix. Adjust your mix of cash, restricted share units, and stock options (including programs like Long-Term Equity)* to where it makes sense for you, and mix it up anytime as life and priorities change. Buying a house? Want more skin in the game? Just experimenting? It’s your call.

 * Flex Comp program offerings vary based on location, role, and employment type. Full details are set out in our Terms & Conditions and related plan documents.

 Built for real life Room for the rest of your life.

 Flexible work, remote by design
 A flexible vacation policy means most Shopifolk can take the vacation days they feel they need to recharge.
 If a change of everyday scenery is more your jam, Destination 90 means you can work from (almost) anywhere in the world for 90 days of the year.

 Your setup
 Your battlestation is your home base. Request the desk, chair, and AV gear you need to get shit done.

 Benefits
 You need ‘em, we’ve got ‘em. Our health and welfare benefits may include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance depending on your country. If you’re in a country without a package, you'll receive a monthly allowance. We also offer mental health support for you and your dependents, including immediate and confidential services like counseling and coaching sessions.

 Family support
 We offer fertility benefits globally, along with paid parental leave to welcome a new family member.

 Applying to work here Show us your craft.

 1 Life Story 
 The Life Story is how we understand the themes of your career journey so far, human to human. What you’ve learned, and how you made a difference. Show us the trophies and the bruises: the problems you’ve solved, the challenges you encountered, the decisions you made, and the lessons you learned along the way.

 2 Craft assessment 
 We’re looking for world-class crafters. Crafters obsessed with pursuing excellence in their field. Our craft assessment looks at your personal journey toward mastery, and your potential to go broader and deeper in novel ways.
 You’ll start with an online assessment, followed by a craft assessment. Show us what you do best, and how you do it. Shopify’s bar is high, and code wins arguments around here. Let your skills do the talking.

 About the discipline Engineering. It’s our DNA. 

 Engineering isn't a department at Shopify. It's our DNA. The engineers who thrive here care about the code, the system, and the merchants relying on both. They want hard problems and uncomfortable growth. They find solutions without waiting for permission. They ship weekly. They want commerce to work better for everyone. So does our founder, Tobi, who still codes and still shapes where this thing is going.
 They're open source nerds. They pair program because two brains write better code than one. New tools, new models, new approaches. They experiment constantly. Most of what's standard here started as someone hacking on something.
 They use AI like a keyboard, reflexively and everywhere, to clear the mundane and make room for thinking. And they work in the open. The fastest way to learn here is to watch someone better than you do the work. If that sounds like you, come build with us.

 Growth and rewards Mastery-matched compensation.

 ~Mastery
 At Shopify, getting better at your craft and increasing your impact is how you grow. Twice a year, we assess both in our ~Mastery cycle, Shopify’s performance review. Achieving higher ~Mastery is a promotion, and when you earn a promotion your total rewards grow with it. Crafter and manager are equal paths, so you can pursue excellence in the craft you’re best at.

 Total Rewards
 With Flex Comp, your Rewards Wallet gives you agency over your compensation mix. Adjust your mix of cash, restricted share units, and stock options (including programs like Long-Term Equity)* to where it makes sense for you, and mix it up anytime as life and priorities change. Buying a house? Want more skin in the game? Just experimenting? It’s your call.

 * Flex Comp program offerings vary based on location, role, and employment type. Full details are set out in our Terms & Conditions and related plan documents.

 2 Craft assessment 
 We’re looking for world-class crafters. Crafters obsessed with pursuing excellence in their field. Our craft assessment looks at your personal journey toward mastery, and your potential to go broader and deeper in novel ways.
 You’ll start with an online assessment, followed by a craft assessment. Show us what you do best, and how you do it. Shopify’s bar is high, and code wins arguments around here. Let your skills do the talking.

 3 Craft interviews 
 Building on your craft assessment, these interviews dive deeper into your experience and technical aptitude. Depending on the role, this may include technical deep dives focusing on projects you've previously worked on, collaborating in a design critique, exploring a dataset using SQL, or taking the lead on solving a problem with your interviewer as your co-pilot.
